name: Conditions + AI exit + signal-strength sizing
activity_note: Closed 2026-10-21: the 2026-10-15 audit found a survivor universe and max-of-18k selection; superseded by Systems 11 and 12. Its paper book was stopped 2026-10-21; the BingX shadow mirror is legacy infrastructure, untouched.
hypothesis: The edge is in choosing the conditions in which to trade - a market gate, a selector, a forecast of the next day - and money management keeps the drawdown under 25%.
data: 15m candles, 14 USDT pairs, research to 2025-12-31, 2026 forward-only, via the shared catalogue
system 06's 44 causal features per bar and its breadth channel
1h / 4h / 1d / 1w views of the coin and BTC, and a lagged macro panel (VIX, Nasdaq, dollar, oil, yields)
mechanism: A gate (BTC vs its N-day average + breadth) allows trading; per regime a selector of four small nets picks the trades; four regressors forecast the next day's return - buy at >= +0.3%, sell below -0.3%, stake proportional to the forecast. The book applies slots, stop, trailing stop, max hold and drawdown-scaled stakes. Configurations are searched walk-forward on 2022-2025 and released when they beat the best on two seed sets.

helped.effect: made max DD <= 25% reachable with the account still trading

helped.what: momentum boost (2x stake, top-5 coins by 90-day return)

hurt.what: every RL variant (full trader, manager, sizer, long/flat/short)
hurt.effect: never beat the rules out of sample (2026 -4%, 2025 swings -26%..+14%)
cost return: the release buys crashes

open.what: A wider universe (32 coins) for the search

open.why: five slots in one BTC move is one bet

rules: buy when the forecast >= +0.3%, sell below -0.3%
x0.75 when BTC is below its 100-day average
stakes shrink with drawdown, to 25% at -35%
